archive_layout.carrier: exact downloaded ZIP split into ordered 1 MiB chunks, with no recompression or member modification

verification_basis: Offline verification of original downloaded carrier and all members, frozen public source closure, original retained input bytes, native token/trace/input chains, and sanitized executed-source receipts. No pip, package, model, or network acquisition was performed during archive preparation.
limitations: Retained evidence validates exact source, identities, transcript/token traces, and input processing; acoustic verbatim completeness remains unknown.
Checkpoint and wheel bodies are excluded from the public artifact; their exact identities and acquisition are verified from frozen locks and executed-source receipts, not by re-downloading.
Pip audited source matches are 22 sanitized worker attestations under the frozen 11-file check; runtime image pip file bodies are not retained in the public artifact.
Setup byte accounting covers bidirectional tunnel socket receives before forwarding; excludes CONNECT headers, kernel buffering and network overhead.
Image-transfer observation is not a hard total-transfer cap or exact daemon accounting; recorded cumulative image transfer bytes are unverified.
No separate setup elapsed-time receipt; all setup is inside the successful 243.72-second host execution, below the 1200-second setup limit, with cleanup deadline flags false.
No standalone source/model worker kernel records are retained; both worker inspect scopes are verified, and the frozen phase worker gates and terminal receipts provide control-flow evidence.
